skills.skill: Add and subtract integers, including negatives

misconceptions.pattern: Treats subtracting a negative as making the value smaller (answers -5 - (-3) as -8), instead of recognizing that subtracting a negative adds.

strategies.intent: Start at the first number on a number line. Adding moves right, subtracting moves left; a negative second number flips the direction, so subtracting a negative moves right (adds).
